 SUBJECT : Response to email dated 1 August 2022 for submission of documents with respect to request dated 21 July 2022 for registration of Loan Agreement dated 18 July 2022 executed by and between Daftarkhwan Holdings Limited and Daftarkhwan (Private) Limited with the State Bank of Pakistan . 
 Dear Sir, 
 
 We write with reference to the application dated 2 1 July 2021 (“ Original Request ”) submitted in accordance with Chapter 19 of the Foreign Exchange Manual, to JS Bank Limited, Plot No. 14-A, Block D-1, Ghalib Road, Gulberg III, Lahore branch (“ Authorized Dealer ”) , for registration of the Loan Agreement dated 18 July 2022 (“ Loan Agreement ”) executed by and between Daftarkhwan (Private) Limited (“ Applicant ”) and Daftarkhwan Holdings Limited (“ Lender ”). 
 
 I n response to the Original Request , the Authorized Dealer issued further instructions vide its email dated 1 A ugust 2022 ( Annexure A ) to the Applicant for submission of the following information: 
 
 Certification of Incorporation and profile of Lender 
 Borrower and L ender relationship 
 Ultimate Beneficial Owner of Lender 
 Undertaking: That No foreign government own or controls the company in any capacity, and has no any resident Pakistani shareholder 
 Clients status listed /unlisted 
 TBML Clearance Undertaking 
 AML / CPF / CFT Review Undertaking 
 Outstanding positions of loans (any currency) against subject customer as per SBP (FCY Loan) 
 Overdue position of subject customer as per SBP (FCY Loan) 
 Outstanding positions of loans internal 
 Any Default / Suit case / Legal involvement in Pakistan or globally etc 
 
 In response to the above, please see our submissions herein below : 
 
 Certificate of incorporation and profile of lender company 
 
 A copy of the Lender’s certificate of incorporation is enclosed as Annexure B. 
 
 A copy of the profile of the L ender has already been submitted as Annexure I to the Original Request , however a copy of the same is enclosed as Annexure C . 
 
 Borrower and lender relationship . 
 
 It is submitted that the Lender is the parent company of the Borrower . 
 
 Ultimate Beneficial Owner of Lender . 
 
 Detail s of ultimate beneficial owner s of the L ender are enclosed as Annexure D . 
 
 
 Undertaking: That No foreign government own or controls the company in any capacity, and has no any resident Pakistani shareholder . 
 
 An undertaking of the Borrower confirming that n o foreign government own or controls the Lender in any capacity is enclosed as Annexure E . 
 
 Clients status listed /unlisted . 
 
 It is submitted that the Borrower is a private limited company incorporated under the law s of Pakistan . 
 
 TBML Clearance Undertakin g. 
 and 
 AML / CPF / CFT Review Undertaking . 
 
 An undertaking by the Borrower confirming that the Borrower is compliant with the applicable Anti-Money Laundering, Combating the Financing of Terrorism and Countering Proliferation Financing ( AML / CFT / CPF ) and Trade-Based Money Laundering (TBML) laws is enclosed as Annexure F . 
 
 Moreover, a n undertaking from the Borrower confirming that the Lender is compliant with the applicable Anti-Money Laundering, Combating the Financing of Terrorism and Countering Proliferation Financing ( AML / CFT / CPF ) and Trade-Based Money Laundering (TBML) laws is enclosed as Annexure G . 
 
 Outstanding positions of loans (any currency) against subject customer as per SBP (FCY Loan . 
 
 It is submitted that the Borrower has not availed any foreign currency loan (FCY) hence there are no foreign currency (FCY) loans outstanding against the Borrower . 
 
 Overdue position of subject customer as per SBP (FCY Loan) . 
 
 It is submitted that the Borrower has not availed any foreign currency loan (FCY) hence there are no overdue foreign currency (FCY) loans . 
 
 Outstanding positions of loans internal . 
 
 It is submitted that the Borrower has not availed any loan from any financial institution in Pakistan h ence there are no outstanding loans internal. 
 
 Any Default / Suit case / Legal involvement in Pakistan or globally etc. 
 
 It is submitted that there is no default / suit case / legal involvement in the name of the Borrower in Pakistan or globally 
 
 We hope the above meets your requirements and that our application for registration of the Loan Agreement and remittance of the Loan Amount to the Borrower’s designated bank account maintained with the Authorized Dealer can be processed expeditiously. 
 
 Should you require any further clarification, p lease do not hesitate to contact us. 
 
 Yours sincerely,

 Ahmad Habib
